answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a ferrous stake — a refundable deposit of tokens or compute — before it may transact, so spawning ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand stakes. Reputation then accrues slowly through verified work, layer by layer like jade forming, and cannot be bought or transferred. New agents start on a low knoll: small transaction limits and no access to shared treasuries until their history proves reliable. A puppet army stays expensive, slow, and small.
